name: ai.twelfth/workspace
description: Retail category-management data for a Twelfth workspace: sales, stock, pricing, suppliers, actions.
title: Twelfth

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. A workspace MCP key as `Bearer twelfth_mcp_…`, made in Settings → AI & agents. Leave it out to sign in with OAuth instead.

ai.twelfth/skills.name: category-review
ai.twelfth/skills.description: Runs a category review on retail sales, margin and stock data the user brings as a spreadsheet, CSV or pasted table. Builds a scorecard (sales, units, gross margin, GMROI, availability) against a comparison period, separates a demand problem from an execution problem, reads the range and promotions, and recommends next steps that fit the category's role. Use when someone asks to "review this category", "how is this category performing", "why is this category down", "is this category earning its keep", "which lines should we cut", "range review", "category health check", "GMROI", "margin versus turns", or "what should we do with this category". Works without any connected system; all figures come from the data supplied.

ai.twelfth/skills.name: competitor-price-check
ai.twelfth/skills.description: Compares a retailer's prices with competitors' using a price list and competitor prices the user brings as a spreadsheet, CSV or pasted table. Matches identical products, normalises pack sizes, separates shelf, promotional and member prices, sets aside marketplace sellers, out-of-stock rows, stale observations and likely listing errors, calculates a weighted price index, and recommends match, hold or ignore per line by KVI status and category role. Use when someone asks "are we competitive", "check our prices against a competitor", "a competitor has undercut us", "what is our price index", "should we match this price", "where are we too expensive", "KVI price check" or "is this competitor price real". Works without any connected system; all figures come from the data supplied.

ai.twelfth/skills.name: range-review
ai.twelfth/skills.description: Run a retail range review on a category from a spreadsheet, CSV or pasted product list. Scores each line on rate of sale, trend, contribution and return on stock, groups lines by the shopper need they serve, estimates where a cut line's buyers would go, and recommends keep, cut, fix stock depth or add, with the net effect on category contribution shown as a calculation. Handles supplier proposals, slow sellers, end-of-life stock and gaps in the range. Use when someone asks "which lines should I delist", "review my range", "rationalise the tail", "what should I cut from this category", "is this slow line worth keeping", "the supplier wants us to range X and drop Y", "how deep should we range this", or shares a product sales export and wants range decisions. Not for diagnosing a sales fall, setting a price, or building a planogram.

ai.twelfth/skills.name: sales-decline-diagnosis
ai.twelfth/skills.description: Diagnose why sales of a category, supplier, brand, range or product fell, working from a spreadsheet, CSV or pasted figures. Splits the change into units, price, mix and returns effects that add up exactly to the fall, then works through the possible causes (availability, range changes, promotions, market demand, competition, visibility), checking the cheapest decisive facts first and saying plainly what is ruled out and what the data cannot show. Use when someone asks "why are sales down", "why did this category drop", "what's driving the decline", "explain the fall versus last year", "is it price or volume", "sales are down 12%, why?", or shares a sales export and wants the drop explained. Not for a plain lookup of last week's sales, a margin-only question, or a forecast.

ai.twelfth/skills.name: supplier-offer-review
ai.twelfth/skills.description: Review a supplier's stock list, offer sheet or price list against your own sales and stock, and work out what to buy. Matches offer lines to your products by barcode or supplier code, works out weeks of cover and a suggested quantity rounded to cartons and minimum order, compares the offered cost with what you pay now, and lists what is missing before you can decide. Use when someone shares a supplier offer, stock list, availability sheet or deal sheet and asks "what should I buy from this", "how many do I need", "is this a good price", "which of these do we already range" or "how much cover do we have on these". Works from spreadsheets alone; no Twelfth account needed.

ai.twelfth/skills.name: twelfth-competitor-pricing
ai.twelfth/skills.description: Answer competitor pricing questions from a Twelfth workspace using the Twelfth MCP pricing tools - where we sit against each competitor, which SKUs a competitor undercuts, how a tracked set reads, what moved this week, when and how one SKU's price changed, and which of our SKUs a retailer's product page is. Reads observed prices on a last-seen or 4/8/12-week basis and flags likely listing errors and pack mismatches. Use when someone asks "are we competitive on X", "who is cheaper", "check competitor prices", "what did competitors do this week", "price index", "review my tracked set", "when did they drop the price" or shares a retailer's product page. Needs the Twelfth MCP server connected.

ai.twelfth/skills.name: twelfth-weekly-trading-brief
ai.twelfth/skills.description: Write a one-page weekly trading brief from a Twelfth workspace using the Twelfth MCP tools - overdue and due actions with owners, the suppliers with the most open recommendations, stock and cover pressure, where prices sit against competitors and this week's market moves, ending with the three things to do first. Use when someone asks for "the weekly brief", "Monday trading update", "what needs my attention this week", "trading summary", "week in review" or a brief focused on one category, supplier or remit. Needs the Twelfth MCP server connected.

ai.twelfth/skills.name: twelfth-workspace
ai.twelfth/skills.description: Answer questions about a Twelfth retail workspace (products, suppliers, sales, inventory, pricing, projects, members and open actions) using the Twelfth MCP tools. Use when the user mentions Twelfth, their workspace, or asks about their own retail or category data.

serverInfo.name: twelfth
serverInfo.title: Twelfth
serverInfo.description: Retail category-management data for one Twelfth workspace: sales, stock, products, suppliers, competitor pricing, projects and recommendations. It reads by default, and makes a short list of changes, such as closing an action or running a routine, only when the person allows changes.

instructions: This Twelfth MCP connection is scoped to one workspace and reads by default. A person's OAuth connection makes changes only if they ticked Allow changes when connecting, and then only as them: twelfth_create_action, twelfth_complete_action and twelfth_snooze_action act on their own tasks; twelfth_run_routine runs a routine they own (a shadow routine publishes nothing); twelfth_update_agent_policy changes the workspace's chat runtime defaults, for Twelfth staff with owner or admin access only. Workspace keys never make changes, and no tool raises an order or changes a price. Start with twelfth_get_workspace for the workspace's timezone and currency. To find sources to cite (products, shared documents, reports, projects, pricing sets, the docs), use search, then fetch a result for its full text and link. Use search_catalogue and find_supplier to resolve products and suppliers before reading their figures; the get_* snapshot tools read only the current work unit, not the whole business. Pricing tools compare tracked SKUs against approved competitors; prices are observed, not live. Prompts offer ready-made briefs (weekly trading brief, explain a recommendation, competitor price check, supplier review, project status); skills (skills/list) carry retail analysis workflows such as diagnosing a sales decline or a category review; and resources expose the workspace, open actions, members and settings as pinned context. Connection setup, API keys and every other change happen in the app. Tool results carry source_evidence_ids that later calls accept.

tools.name: twelfth_get_workspace
tools.description: Get the connected workspace's name, slug, timezone, currency and country. Call it first so dates and money are read in the workspace's own terms; for people use twelfth_list_workspace_members.
tools.title: Get workspace

tools.name: twelfth_list_workspace_members
tools.description: List up to 100 people in the connected workspace with their email and role. Use it to resolve an owner or assignee by name; for what each person has open use twelfth_list_open_actions.
tools.title: List workspace members

tools.name: twelfth_list_open_actions
tools.description: List up to 100 open actions visible to this connection, soonest due first, with assignee, remit and the work unit each came from. Use it for what is due or overdue; for project-level progress use twelfth_list_projects.
tools.title: List open actions

dueAt.description: ISO timestamp, or null when undated.

bookKey.description: The remit the action belongs to; null for workspace-wide.

actions.description: Up to 100 open actions, soonest due first.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search this workspace's citable records in one call: catalogue products, shared documents, reports Twelfth wrote, projects, saved pricing sets and Twelfth's product documentation. Returns up to 20 results, each with an id, a title, a short snippet and an absolute link to the record in Twelfth. Use it when the question needs sources to read and cite; pass a result's id to fetch for its full text. For figures across the product range use twelfth_list_products, and for a known product search_catalogue.

query.description: What to look for, in plain words: a product, brand, document title, project name, report subject or a how-to question.

tools.title: Search

id.description: Pass to fetch to read the record in full.

url.description: Absolute link to the record in Twelfth, for citation.

text.description: A short snippet saying what the record is.

results.description: Up to 20 results across products, documents, reports, projects, pricing sets and the docs.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read one record a search result named, in full: its id, title, text, absolute link to it in Twelfth and metadata. Text is capped at about 45,000 characters; a longer record says where it was cut. Use it after search to read and cite a result. For one page of a long shared document use read_document, and for a report's figures as data use read_report.

id.description: A result id from search, such as product:<sku>, document:<id>, report:<id>, project:<id>, tracked_set:<id> or docs:<page>.

tools.title: Fetch

text.description: The record's full text, cut at about 45,000 characters to fit the result budget.

url.description: Absolute link to the record in Twelfth, for citation.

kind.description: product, document, report, project, tracked_set or docs.

truncated.description: True when the text does not hold the whole record.

tools.name: twelfth_get_preferences
tools.description: Read stored preference values and the keys this connection may read at user, organization or membership scope. Use it for defaults such as cover targets and display choices. For Twelfth staff with workspace owner/admin access, organization scope also returns the managed chat runtime policy and available models. Those staff with Allow changes can use twelfth_update_agent_policy for runtime settings. Integrations and category remits have their own tools (twelfth_list_integration_guides, twelfth_list_category_settings); personal and membership scopes need a person's OAuth connection.

scope.description: Whose preferences to read: user (your account), organization (the workspace) or membership (your role in this workspace). A workspace key can read organization only.

tools.title: Get preferences

agentPolicy.description: Effective chat runtime, overrides, available model IDs and this connection's write eligibility.

keys.description: Preference keys this connection can read at this scope.

tools.name: twelfth_list_projects
tools.description: List the workspace's projects visible to this connection, with workflow, stage, owner, open and overdue task counts. Use it to find a project or see what is in flight; for one project's tasks, documents and activity use get_project with its id.

state.description: Which projects to list by lifecycle state. Defaults to live.

workflow.description: Only projects on this workflow key, from twelfth_list_project_workflows.

tools.title: List projects

asOf.description: ISO timestamp the list was read at.

tools.name: twelfth_list_project_workflows
tools.description: List the project workflows this workspace offers, with their stages, availability and how many projects run on each. Use it to explain what kinds of project exist; for actual projects use twelfth_list_projects.
tools.title: List project workflows

tools.name: twelfth_list_routines
tools.description: List the routines this connection can see (a person's own and the workspace's global ones; a workspace key sees global ones only), with each routine's schedule, mode (live, or shadow: records what it would raise and publishes nothing), checks, owner, open tasks and last run. Use it to find a routine or see what runs when; for one routine's runs, mutes and shadow output use twelfth_get_routine, and for the tasks routines raised use twelfth_list_open_actions.

state.description: Which routines by state. Defaults to active.

who.description: all (default), mine (the person owns it) or global (the workspace's shared routines).

tools.title: List routines

mode.description: shadow records what it would raise and publishes nothing.

nextRunAt.description: ISO timestamp, or null while paused or archived.

canEdit.description: Whether this person may change it in Twelfth.

checks.description: The checks it runs; empty for a checklist or engine routine.

scheduledFor.description: The occurrence it ran for, ISO timestamp.

summary.description: What the run found, in a sentence.

dataAsOf.description: The data the run read, ISO timestamp.

held.description: Flagged lines not raised because the buyer chose no action on the same evidence.

muted.description: Lines not flagged because a check is muted on that product.

action.description: What the task would ask for: order, review, price_review, price_change, transfer or engine.

group.description: The group the task would cover (a supplier, category or remit), or null for one task.

flagged.description: Of those, lines a check flagged.

items.description: A sample of the lines, flagged first: up to 25 per task, on the first 40 tasks.

signals.description: The signals that flagged the line.

orderQty.description: The suggested order quantity, when there is one; always null on a running-hot line, which is looked at, not ordered.

price.description: A price check's recommended price, when one recommends a price.

findings.description: What each check recorded on the line: a price check, a sell-out scan or a running-hot check where it flagged, a planned buy on every line.

checkKey.description: The check that recorded it, e.g. competitor_undercut, lost_sales_uncompetitive, cover_to_next_run, sell_out_risk or running_hot.

evidence.description: What it saw: the competitor, their price, our price, the gap, when it was seen; for lost sales, the rate of sale before and after; for a planned buy, the cover in days (next run + lead time), demand over it, available, on order, carton, MOQ, the quantity, or why the line was not sized; for a sell-out scan, a sentence (message), days of cover, the days until stock can arrive (arrivalDays; leadDefaulted when the supplier has no lead time and the 28-day default stood in) and the planned run it waited for, the order and its cover, or why the line was not checked; for a running-hot check, a sentence (message), the mode (forecast or usual), units sold over the days judged, expected and upper for those days, the recent and expected pace, available, on order (null when not known), and cover at that pace against its threshold, or why the line was not checked.

wouldRaise.description: What a shadow run would have raised. Nothing was published.

missingLeadTime.description: A buying check's suppliers in scope with no lead time: their products are sized (planned buy) and checked (sell-out scan) on a 28-day lead-time default, flagged on each line, until one is entered.

names.description: The first ten, most products first.

setAside.description: Price sightings a price check found outside the position but did not flag: a competitor's promo price, or a suspected product mismatch.

onPromo.description: Lines undercut by a competitor's promo price. A promo raises no price work.

suspectedMismatch.description: Lines priced so far above a competitor (over 50% by default) that the match is suspect: for match review, not price work.

observedAt.description: The day the competitor price was seen, YYYY-MM-DD.

overPct.description: Our price above the competitor's, in percent.

gapPct.description: How far outside the allowed price, in percent of it.

items.description: One per line, competitor and reason, widest gap first: at most 200.

tools.name: twelfth_get_routine
tools.description: Read one routine: its checks, schedule, scope, mode, standing instructions, its last 10 runs with what each found, the products muted under its checks, and for a routine in shadow mode what its latest run would have raised, grouped by action and group, with a sample of the lines (shadow routines publish nothing). Use it to explain what a routine does or what a shadow routine would raise; to find its id use twelfth_list_routines, and for the tasks it raised use twelfth_list_open_actions.

tools.name: twelfth_list_integration_guides
tools.description: See which data and chat integrations this workspace has connected, what each provides, and the Twelfth page where a person can connect or configure it. Use it to answer what is connected or how to connect something. It never starts OAuth or changes a connection; for stored workspace defaults use twelfth_get_preferences.
tools.title: List integration guides

state.description: connection_present, grant_present, managed_by_twelfth, not_connected or check_in_app.

tools.name: twelfth_list_category_settings
tools.description: Read managed categories, their aliases and which remit owns each, narrowed to this connection's readable remits, 50 per page with total and hasMore. Use it to map category names and find category IDs for twelfth_list_products filters; pass query to find one category by name or alias. Changing categories is owner/admin-only in the app.

query.description: Case-insensitive text matched against each category's label, key and aliases.

offset.description: Categories to skip, for paging. Default 0.

tools.title: List category settings

categories.description: This page of managed categories, with their aliases and remit ownership.

total.description: Categories matching the query, across every page.

hasMore.description: True when a later page holds more categories; call again with offset + limit.

unmapped.description: Raw category values not yet mapped to a managed category, at most 100.

unmappedTotal.description: How many raw category values are unmapped in all.

canWriteViaMcp.description: Always false: this connection cannot change it.

tools.name: twelfth_list_products
tools.description: Page through every product in this connection's readable remits with current stock, velocity, cover, sales, GP%, price, supplier, category and open finding count; an unmeasured figure is null. Use it for figures across the whole range, sorted or filtered. To find a product by name first, search_catalogue is lighter.

query.description: Case-insensitive search text for a product, e.g. a name, brand or SKU.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging. Default 0.

sort.description: Column to order by. Defaults to name.

categoryIds.description: Only products in these category IDs, from twelfth_list_category_settings.

remitKeys.description: Only products in these remits (book keys) the connection can read.

suppliers.description: Only products from these supplier names.

tools.title: List products

position.description: Current stock, velocity, cover, sales, GP% and price; an unmeasured figure is null.

url.description: Absolute link to the same page, when the app origin is known.

scope.description: whole_business for an owner/admin or workspace key, otherwise the caller's remits.

url.description: Absolute link to the same page, when the app origin is known.

canWriteViaMcp.description: Always false: this connection cannot change it.

tools.name: twelfth_get_products
tools.description: Read up to 100 named products by SKU in one call, with the same stock, velocity, cover, sales, GP%, price, supplier and category figures as twelfth_list_products; an unmeasured figure is null. A SKU that is unknown or outside this connection's readable remits is listed in notFound, not raised as an error. Use it to fill in a known list of SKUs, such as a spreadsheet column; to search, filter or page the range use twelfth_list_products, and to find a SKU from a name use search_catalogue.

skus.description: 1 to 100 product SKUs, matched exactly first and then case-insensitively. Repeats are read once.

tools.title: Get products

position.description: Current stock, velocity, cover, sales, GP% and price; an unmeasured figure is null.

url.description: Absolute link to the same page, when the app origin is known.

products.description: The found products, in request order, each once.

notFound.description: Requested SKUs that are unknown or outside this connection's readable remits.

currency.description: The workspace's trading currency (ISO 4217) that every price and money figure here is in.

scope.description: whole_business for an owner/admin or workspace key, otherwise the caller's remits.

tools.name: read_report
tools.description: Read one report Twelfth wrote: key actions, insights, facts and each figure's rows (capped at 50). Use it to compare periods or carry an action forward; get the id from list_reports or find_artefacts. For a shared sheet or doc use read_document.

report_id.description: The report's id, from list_reports, find_artefacts or RECENT REPORTS.

tools.title: Read report

source_evidence_ids.description: Workspace evidence IDs backing these rows. Empty when the source carries no evidence records.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Read one project as it stands: workflow stage, scope, owner, open tasks, documents, artefacts and recent activity. Use it for where a piece of work is up to and who holds it; to find the project's id use twelfth_list_projects.

projectId.description: The project id from THIS PROJECT or a project link.

tools.title: Get project

source_evidence_ids.description: Workspace evidence IDs backing these rows. Empty when the source carries no evidence records.

tools.name: recall_decisions
tools.description: Read past committed decisions (buys, price moves, transfers, EOL marks and reversals, negotiation outcomes) with the rationale recorded at the time, filtered by supplier or brand, one product's SKU, category, remit, project template or dates. Use it for what we decided before and why. It does not judge outcomes; for current recommendations use get_entity_context.

supplier.description: The supplier or brand house, as named in the workspace. In the beauty world a brand house is the supplier.

query.description: Words matched against product name, SKU, the unit's title, the rationale and line notes. Every word must match.

sku.description: One product's SKU, exactly as the workspace holds it (any case). Reads the decisions that included that line and puts it first in each; use this, not query, when you have the SKU.

category.description: A workspace category label or id, case-insensitive.

remit.description: A remit bookKey. One the caller cannot read is ignored and reported in scope.remits_ignored.

template.description: The project template the decision was taken in.

kinds.description: Which kinds of decision to read; all when omitted. Product updates include EOL marks and reversals.

from.description: First Melbourne day, inclusive. Defaults to 400 days before `to`.

to.description: Last Melbourne day, inclusive. Defaults to today.

overrides_only.description: Only decisions with at least one line that went against twelfth's recommendation.

limit.description: How many decisions to return, 1 to 25; default 12.

tools.title: Recall decisions

kind.description: purchase_order, price_change, stock_transfer, product_update or negotiation.

tools.name: get_negotiation_trading
tools.description: Read the trading behind a supplier negotiation's fact base, cut by supplier, week, promotion, line or service (how each supplier delivers, from PO receipts). Use it for the numbers behind a negotiation; for the fact base itself use get_fact_base.

projectId.description: The project id from THIS PROJECT.

cut.description: How to cut the trading: supplier, week, promo, line or service.

window.description: Weeks; defaults to the workspace's cost-of-goods window.

supplierId.description: Narrow to one supplier, by the id the fact base lists.

tools.title: Get negotiation trading

source_evidence_ids.description: Workspace evidence IDs backing these rows. Empty when the source carries no evidence records.

tools.name: get_fact_base
tools.description: Read a supplier negotiation's fact base: the category read, suppliers, kept entries, lever coverage and kick-off claims. Use it before saying what the fact base contains; for the trading figures use get_negotiation_trading.

projectId.description: The project id from THIS PROJECT.

tools.title: Get fact base

source_evidence_ids.description: Workspace evidence IDs backing these rows. Empty when the source carries no evidence records.

outputSchema.description: One phase of a supplier negotiation project, as it stands now.

tools.name: get_strategy
tools.description: Read a supplier negotiation's Strategy phase: settled outcomes, targets, supplier tiers and positions, plays, line decisions, asks and approval. Use it before quoting the strategy; for the asks in detail use get_ask.

projectId.description: The project id from THIS PROJECT.

tools.title: Get strategy

source_evidence_ids.description: Workspace evidence IDs backing these rows. Empty when the source carries no evidence records.

outputSchema.description: One phase of a supplier negotiation project, as it stands now.

tools.name: get_ask
tools.description: Read a supplier negotiation's Ask phase per supplier: the ask against the cap, range changes, levers, justification, gives, objections, walk-away and delivery. Use it before quoting an ask; for rounds and offers use get_negotiate.

projectId.description: The project id from THIS PROJECT.

tools.title: Get ask

source_evidence_ids.description: Workspace evidence IDs backing these rows. Empty when the source carries no evidence records.

outputSchema.description: One phase of a supplier negotiation project, as it stands now.

tools.name: rehearse
tools.description: Return a brief for rehearsing the ask with a supplier persona (difficult, pushing_hard, warm_partner, silent or custom). Use it to practise before a meeting; for the ask itself use get_ask.

projectId.description: The project id from THIS PROJECT.

persona.description: How the supplier's negotiator behaves; custom follows the brief.

brief.description: How the person wants the supplier played, for custom or on top of a persona.

tools.title: Rehearse

tools.name: get_negotiate
tools.description: Read a supplier negotiation's Negotiate phase: per-supplier status, rounds, latest offer, agreement, escalation, models and lines. Use it before quoting where a negotiation stands; to weigh models use compare_models.

projectId.description: The project id from THIS PROJECT.

tools.title: Get negotiate

source_evidence_ids.description: Workspace evidence IDs backing these rows. Empty when the source carries no evidence records.

outputSchema.description: One phase of a supplier negotiation project, as it stands now.

tools.name: compare_models
tools.description: Compare two or three negotiation models in words: this year's value, what recurs, and who is left under the walk-away. Use it to choose between models; for their figures use get_negotiate.

projectId.description: The project id from THIS PROJECT.

modelIds.description: Two or three model ids from get_negotiate.

tools.title: Compare models

tools.name: nudge
tools.description: Return a supplier's position and a brief for drafting a follow-up after the response window. Nothing is sent. Use it when a supplier has gone quiet; for the full round history use get_negotiate.

projectId.description: The project id from THIS PROJECT.

tools.title: Nudge

tools.name: get_sign_off
tools.description: Read a supplier negotiation's Sign-off phase: outcomes per supplier, cost and range against target, and the sign-off state. Use it for how a negotiation landed; for the follow-through use get_apply.

projectId.description: The project id from THIS PROJECT.

tools.title: Get sign off

source_evidence_ids.description: Workspace evidence IDs backing these rows. Empty when the source carries no evidence records.

outputSchema.description: One phase of a supplier negotiation project, as it stands now.

tools.name: get_apply
tools.description: Read a supplier negotiation's Apply phase: hand-off tasks, supplier record notes and learnings. Use it for what is left to action after sign-off; for the outcome itself use get_sign_off.

projectId.description: The project id from THIS PROJECT.

tools.title: Get apply

source_evidence_ids.description: Workspace evidence IDs backing these rows. Empty when the source carries no evidence records.

outputSchema.description: One phase of a supplier negotiation project, as it stands now.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search Twelfth's product documentation for how a page, control or setting works, returning matching sections with links. Use it before saying Twelfth cannot do something. An empty result means the docs do not describe it, not that the product lacks it. For documents the workspace shared use read_document.

query.description: The user's question in their own words. Plain language beats product jargon; the corpus is written the way a customer would ask.

tools.title: Search docs

slug.description: The page's slug; fetch reads the whole page as docs:<slug>.

clipped.description: True when the section text was shortened.

tools.name: price_intel_summary
tools.description: Read our whole-market price index for a 4, 8 or 12-week window, plus the tracked competitor directory. Use it for where we sit overall against each competitor; for specific SKUs use price_intel_lookup or twelfth_compare_pricing_skus.

window.description: Rolling window in weeks; defaults to 4.

tools.title: Price intel summary

evidence_id.description: Handle for these rows within this call's results. Not a citation.

total_matching_rows.description: Rows that matched before any limit.

truncated.description: True when more rows matched than were returned.

rows.description: Whole-market price index rows for the window.

source_evidence_ids.description: Workspace evidence IDs backing these rows. Empty when the source carries no evidence records.

tools.name: get_exchange_rate
tools.description: Read the latest dated reference exchange rate for one currency pair, including source and cached status. Use it to estimate a foreign price in the workspace currency; omitted to_currency uses that currency, AUD by default. The rate is indicative, not a booked or bank settlement rate. For supplier identities use find_supplier instead.

from_currency.description: ISO currency of the original amount, such as USD.

to_currency.description: ISO target currency; omit for the workspace currency, AUD by default.

tools.title: Get exchange rate

outputSchema.description: A dated indicative reference rate; rate and as_of can be null when unavailable or undated.
